lines.english: "Ah…"
"Ogiso… Thank goodness. I made it somehow."
"Sugiura…?"
"You're having politics and economics today, right? Time sure flies and now it's the real thing, huh?"
"But why are you…?"
"I want to apologize."
"I'm sorry I said such terrible things yesterday. I wasn't considerate about your situation at all despite the fact that you were having entrance exams today, Ogiso!"
"H-Hey, stop this! Everyone's looking at us!"
"…Sorry."
"…Did you go out of your way to wait for me just to tell me this?"
"There are things that I couldn't say over the phone, and I wanted to apologize to you face to face…"
"Sugiura…"
"And I wanted to do it before your exam starts. I didn't want all the effort you've put in up until now to go to waste because of me."
"I-It's not like I was bothered all that much, you know. I didn't work all that hard compared to everyone else anyway, and I'm used to you getting mad at me, Sugiura."
"Still, I know that I've been right in our exchanges up until now, but you were the one who was right yesterday, Ogiso…"
"…So you're saying that I've always been wrong up until now."
"Ah, sorry. Again, I'm…"
"…No, it's alright. That's just like you, Sugiura."
"Just like me, huh…"
"Yeah. I feel like I'm talking with the Sugiura I knew from last year. …You seem like you've gotten over your problem already."
"…You know, Ogiso?"
"Hm?"
"I have… a lot of things I have to tell you."
"…Is that so?"
"Someday, I want to tell you all about it. I want you to know just what kind of a person I am. …On top of that, I really want to apologize."
"It seems like a lot has happened, Sugiura. …Though I don't have a clue as to what."
"But I hope that you can focus on your exam right now. I'm really sorry about what happened yesterday. And I wish you all the best today."
"Got it. …To be honest, talking with you like this cleared my mind. I feel like I can handle today's exam just fine."
"…I really am sorry, okay?"
"You don't have to keep repeating it. …Alright, it's about time I went to the classroom."
"I hope you get accepted."
"It's obvious that I'll get accepted, right? We'll attend the same university by the start of spring. I'll look forward to it."
"…Alright then, good luck."
"Yeah, later!"
"…Sorry, Ogiso. We can't… attend university together."
"Good morning, everyone."
"Good morning～!"
"Umm, before our meeting today, there's something Sugiura-san wants to say. …Come on, Sugiura-san."
"Yes."
"Everyone, good morning. I'm Sugiura."
"It's sudden, but I'll take this opportunity to announce that today I will be resigning from my job here."
"It's been three months since I began working here."
"I slowly got used to the work bit by bit, I'm sorry that I have to quit after I've finally proven myself useful to everyone."
"I can't tell you the details because it's a personal matter, but for now, I plan to focus on my studies."
"I'm grateful for all the immense care each and every one of you has given me over the past three months. I will definitely use the experience and knowledge I've acquired here in my new environment."
"Lastly… Acting Manager, Floor Manager, and everyone. I am really sorry for suddenly imposing on everyone like this. Also… thank you for everything."
"Goodbye. Please take care, everyone."
After that, Koharu bowed deeply, and everyone gave her a warm applause.
Even if no one ever saw this coming, Satou, Nakagawa-san, and the other core staff members still warmly bid her goodbye.
"Alright, that's it for now. Everyone, please get ready for opening hours～"
"Hey～ hey～ Koharucchi～ Koharucchi～"
"Ah, Floor Manager… Thank you for taking care of me all this time…"
"Never mind that～ Come, come… Come over here for just a bit."
"Ah, yes…?"
And that wasn't the end of it. Even after her speech, the girls gathered around Koharu to express how reluctant they were to say goodbye with happy and sad expressions alike.

I was suddenly called back to work here, and I had to put up with a lot that I couldn't handle despite how I was initially supposed to be only working in shifts as a trainer. Even so, perhaps I couldn't have asked for a better workplace in terms of the atmosphere…
"Okay then, I think today I will also go hom…"
"I'll hate you for a lifetime, Kitahara-san…"
It only took me ten seconds to take back my previous statement.
"What is it? Is she pregnant? Student marriage? Are you trying to create a scandal before you graduate?"
"No way. She said it herself, right? She wants to focus on her studies…"
"But she will graduate soon. She could at least continue until university starts in April… So in the meantime, Kitahara-san could train someone else…"
"I did say I'll take a break for a while, right? …Well, if I'm needed, I can come back after April…"
"I'll hate you even in my next life, Kitahara-san～"
"Stop it, okay? I did enough for this restaurant's sake, right? And she did too."
"It's a huge loss because you guys are so reliable～ Even if we started hiring urgently right now, I doubt we'd find someone who can pull their weight immediately."
"She considered that herself when she made her choice. Just send her off with a smile."
"Haah… Well, I'll do it for Sugiura-san. That's why I'm taking it out on you."
It seems she was really worried about this.
Given that this is the only place she can truly be herself among a large group of people as of now, it's really hard for her to let go of such a place.
She struggled with it all night, on the verge of tears the whole time, but she finally made her decision this morning.
"Well, anyway, I'll step in if things get hectic. I'll go home for now."
"…Okay, good work."
"See you in April～!"
"Like I said, don't assume that I'll definitely come back. I will be a working man next year, alright?"
"Haah…"
"Kyaaaaa～!"
"Oh, you little! So you actually did do it, come on!"
"W-Wait! It hurts, it hurts, Floor Manager!"
…The girls' farewell ceremony sure is quite noisy.
"Sorry for the wait, Senpai!"
"…I imagine they were quite reluctant to say goodbye to you."
"Yeah. They showered me with hugs…"
"Is… that so…"
She still looked happy though…
Koharu had her ponytail half untied and smiled genuinely, but her red eyes implied how emotionally touching the farewell was.
"I also talked with everyone. With this, I have no more regrets…"
"You don't have to put it as if the world's about to end. …You'll be able to come back to the restaurant again when the opportunity arrives."
"…I'm prepared to move on. With an unwavering conviction."
As she said that, the bittersweet expression she had up until a moment ago disappeared, replaced instead with a stern look that did look as though it had the "unwavering conviction" she described.
…Her red eyes are still not back to normal, though.
"Alright, let's go to the bookstore first. Then go back to my apartment to make a plan. We'll decide on the objective today and act tomorrow."
"Okay…"
"Our schedule will be fully packed from now on. We won't have time to rest. …If we go on with your plan, that is."
"Yes, please. …I'm sorry for involving you in this."
"Honestly, for me, I want you to reconsider that objective again…"
"…That won't happen. I'm truly sorry."
"…It'll be very demanding, you know? Rather, I think about 90% of it is impossible for this year."
"…I suppose so."
"You won't regret it?"
"I will. I will regret it no matter what I choose."
"That's why I will take the choice with less regrets… The choice that will result in comparatively less people getting hurt."
"So, umm…"
"Haruki-senpai, if…"
"U-Umm… if you think you had enough of me, Senpai, you… don't have to force yourself… I'll be fine by… myself… uue…"
"Don't get hurt by your own assumptions! I didn't say anything like that!"
"B-But… but Senpai! You suddenly went silent… so I thought you've had enough of me… uee…!"
"You know I won't abandon you now, Koharu. …I will accompany you even to the depths of hell."
"…! Y-Yes… th-thank you… very much. I really am… sorry. Right now, I really need you, Senpai… uu…"
Koharu, who wept over her failure of attempting to resolve everything herself last night…
Has now fallen into quite the troublesome state after merely a day; she's gathered her courage and determination, but she's also dependent on someone.
"Anyway, the die has been cast. Be it half a month, a month, a year, or…"
"Perhaps I'll have to bear with it forever…"
"…Let's get moving. With your unwavering conviction, that is."
"Yes!"
But her current change is no cause for concern to me.
After all, Koharu's current situation is considerably better than what it was before.
I remember how she handled things so straightforwardly and single-mindedly back when we first met…
And I can see that signs of the bright, charming and straight-laced girl who's difficult to handle are returning.
"By the way, what was with the commotion before? It did seem as though Nakagawa-san and the others were doting on you quite a bit."
"Ahh～ About that…"
"Do you always get teased by them?"
"Y-Yeah… well… if I had to say, rather than me…"
"Well, just a little is fine, right? Hurting Senpai's reputation just a little."
"Like I said! About you and Kitahara-san!"
"Since you two came here together and are resigning together…"
"No, Senpai becoming my trainer was totally a coincidence."
"Then what about you two resigning together?"
"Kitahara-san's always been so rigid and serious, so I imagine everyone would be really interested to know how a younger girl managed to make him fall for her!"
"It was Senpai who showed interest…"
"So, how was it? Now is the perfect time to talk about it, you know～"
"How's it going between you two? How far did you go? Did you kiss?"
"…I don't know whether you can use this as reference, but…"
"Yeah, yeah…!"
"We only made love in the restaurant once."
"Kyaaaaa～!"
